hero.subtitle: I think about brands the way a bartender thinks about a room — who's drinking what, why they're laughing, when to refill.
manifesto.label: § 01 — Manifesto
manifesto.heading: The room reads itself.
manifesto.p1: Most marketing decks open with the audience. Mine open with the bartender. The audience is already in the room — they ordered, they're sitting somewhere, they're checking the time. The job is not to introduce yourself.
manifesto.p2: I write the way a good editor edits — by removing two-thirds of what doesn't belong, then moving the comma. I think in arcs, in tension, in the small detail that makes a stranger recognise themselves on page 3.
